question: Over a pre-registered 5x5x5 grid of three core SPIKE V12.9 signal thresholds (density width, three-bar advance, volume ratio), does the cell selected on Binance ETH 15m 2020-07..2024-01 beat the default parameters and stay net positive on OKX ETH 15m and Binance ETH 15m 2024-02..2026-10?
owner_approval: 2026-10-11 做参数优化，先用15m ETH试 (after the provenance answer; owner decides threshold changes).
single_variable: Signal-threshold triple only; every other V12.9 rule fixed: BB200 compression admission, rope distance <= 3 ATR, RV <= 50, UTC-Sunday rule, completed 1h SMA60 direction gate, next-open fill, 5-bar stop, 2R-armed 4ATR trail, raw opposite exit, 0.2% round trip, ordinary both-side signals only.
where_thresholds_act: dense width: _legacy pastWidth <= W; advance and volume: _legacy quality gate and the V6 structural evidence envelope (both use the same 1.5/1.5 in V12.9).
selection_rule: Among cells with >= 60 closed selection trades, maximize the neighbourhood-smoothed mean net R (the cell and its +-1 grid neighbours along each axis, eligible cells only). The raw best cell is reported for contrast.
pass_rule: Selected cell: on both validation venues mean net R > 0 and > the default cell's; OKX matched-random excess (one draw per trade, same side x UTC week x fold x ATR bucket) p < 0.05 = worth forward observation, p < 0.01 = project bar.
diagnostics: Spearman correlation of selection vs validation mean net R over cells with >= 30 trades in both; validation of the selection top 10.
